commands.title: Pixel Grid: Toggle Auto Line Spacing

pixelGrid.cellRatio.description: Square cell side, as a multiple of font size. Line height is set to this and letter spacing is widened so each character is this wide.

pixelGrid.charWidthRatio.description: Natural width of one monospace character as a multiple of font size (Menlo/Monaco/Consolas ~0.6).

pixelGrid.size.description: Rows/columns of the pixel art grid.
